description: This file defines the Coocook::Base package, a Perl module that sets up common pragmas, features, and import behaviors for other modules in the project. It provides an import method to handle loading additional packages with specific configurations, especially for Moose and related modules.

classes.name: Coocook::Base
classes.description: A base package that enables common Perl pragmas and manages module imports, especially handling Moose and related modules.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Handles importing specified packages, with special handling for Moose modules, and sets up Perl features and pragmas accordingly.
